raw.rationale: This compound is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) whose annotated targets are dominated by cyclooxygenases and related lipid/PPAR proteins, with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-concentration viability screens of such launched NSAIDs typically show no lineage-selective killing above baseline. Therefore probabilities are near the low end of the stated 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with only minor variation for lineages where COX/PPAR biology or transporter expression might marginally influence viability.
